reasons.persona_fit: Accurately targets a 1–10 person business owner with Bareni's calm, practical tone, restrained humor, and strict adherence to the no-CTA rule.
reasons.clarity: The argument develops logically from identifying visibility loss to defining a practical diagnostic rule in clean, jargon-free prose.
reasons.actionability: Provides a feasible manual audit step and a sharp qualification rule to determine whether digital automation or AI is appropriate.
reasons.factual_grounding: Makes no fabricated customer, capability, or performance claims, and maintains realistic boundaries around workflow automation.
